concurrency: Sequential arms; one local Chrome tab per arm. No compute swarm.
isolation: Instructed directory/context separation, not OS enforced.
difference: Only treatment installs and uses packaged Motion MCP tools. Both receive identical design guidance and ordinary Chrome/source tools.
recording: Initial fan diagnostic recordings only. No final control/treatment pair recorded.
budgetAccounting: Equal eight-minute wall-clock deadline, includes tool waits; coordinator enforces it. Maximum two source iterations. Actual shorter completion is permitted.
recipeValidationCorrection: Original demo request rejected before any demo measurement: exceeded 16 actions and 12000ms. Corrected equally for all arms before endpoint evaluation; rejected response retained.

discardedTrials.reason: Initial nominal six-active-minute limit overrun; approximately 8m48 active reported. Retained, excluded from measured pair. No endpoint comparison or winner assessed.

sourceFreeze: Separate coordinator timer copies runtime input/source at each deadline; later worker edits cannot change measured endpoints.
localBrowserRecordings: Supplementary canvas recording was proposed but never performed before user scope change.
stopReason: User explicitly rejected the simple fan demo and requested a much harder, aesthetically impressive motion-rich site. Second control interrupted, treatment not started.
